Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of social and health services to inspect boarding homes at least every eighteen months.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the timing of the inspection of boarding homes;and amending RCW 18.20.110.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.20.110 and 2000 c 47 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall make or cause to be made, at least ((ayearly)) every eighteen months, with a twelvemonth average, aninspection and investigation of all boarding homes. Every inspectionshall focus primarily on actual or potential resident outcomes, and mayinclude an inspection of every part of the premises and an examinationof all records (other than financial records), methods ofadministration, the general and special dietary, and the stores andmethods of supply. Following such an inspection or inspections,written notice of any violation of this law or the rules adoptedhereunder shall be given to the applicant or licensee and thedepartment. The department may prescribe by rule that any licensee orapplicant desiring to make specified types of alterations or additionsto its facilities or to construct new facilities shall, beforecommencing such alteration, addition, or new construction, submit plans p. 1 SHB 1694and specifications therefor to the agencies responsible for planreviews for preliminary inspection and approval or recommendations withrespect to compliance with the rules and standards herein authorized.
